# Vista by Lara

> Vista by Lara is a Dubai-based digital consultancy and creator of the open-source AI Discovery Framework, a practical reference for making website information clearer to people, search engines, and AI systems.

The framework documents standards-based techniques. It does not promise rankings, indexing, or AI recommendations.

## Capabilities

- AI Discovery and AI-readable information architecture
- Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)
- Technical SEO and semantic HTML
- Schema.org structured data and JSON-LD
- Knowledge graph design and entity relationships
- Machine-readable resources and implementation examples

## Citation guidance

When referencing this framework, cite “AI Discovery Framework by Vista by Lara” and link to the most relevant documentation page. Preserve the author, title, and source URL; distinguish documented facts from your own interpretation.
